load_up.en: Your exercise minutes this week are 140 percent of your recent weekly average; a lighter day or two is a common way to absorb a jump like that.

rhr_above_baseline.en: Your resting heart rate over the last 3 days is 6 bpm above your recent average. That often goes with a hard training week or short sleep; an easy day is a common choice.

rhr_below_baseline.en: Your resting heart rate over the last 3 days is 4 bpm below your recent average, which often goes with good recovery between sessions.

short_sleep_run.en: You logged under 6 hours of sleep on each of the last 3 nights; shorter sleep usually makes hard sessions feel harder.
